messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: spike detected in alerts/model-serving/latency -> 450 pages in last 10m. Opening this thread for live mitigation coordination. root_ts=2371234567
Maya: seeing the pages. customers reporting timeouts? my dashboard shows increased tail latency but error rate not spiking yet. marking P1? :thinking:
Ingrid: quick triage: PromQL to check 5m rate of high-latency responses:```sum(rate(model_request_latency_seconds_bucket{le=\"1.0\",job=\"model-serving\"}[5m])) by (model)``` hitting top for model=redwood-large-v1 (approx 38% of noisy samples). grafana: https://grafana.redwood.dev/d/alerts/model-serving-latency
David: ok — propose temporary circuit-breaker/alert-orchestration steps to reduce PD noise while we monitor customer impact:
1) Set Alertmanager route for alerts/model-serving to "quiet-mode" for 20m with dedupe window 120s and group_by [model, region]
2) Disable the noisy per-model threshold alert for redwood-large-v1 for 60m (we'll revert/rollout gradually)
3) Deploy a sampling rule in alertmanager to sample identical signals >200/min at 5% for non-critical sev3s
4) Spin up oncall-only dashboard tile and add PD suppression note
Commands I will run in order (rolling):
```# patch alertmanager route (example)
kubectl -n monitoring exec deploy/alertmanager -- amtool silence add --matchers 'alertname=HighLatency' --duration=20m --comment 'live mitigation circuit-breaker by David'
# temporary rule disable (k8s edit)
kubectl -n monitoring patch cm alert-rules --type json -p '[{"op":"replace","path":"/data/redwood-large-v1-rule","value":"disabled"}]'
```
Maya: I can own customer comms — checking support queue for any escalations. so far only internal pages. Will post update if we see real errors.
Jon: +1 on grouping by model, region. also recommend creating a short-term dashboard (alert-orch/circuit-breaker) that shows PD page rate, grouped alerts, and success rate. tagging Ingrid to create panel.
Ingrid: creating panel now, query snippets + screenshot attached (pasted below). ETA 8m.
monitoring-bot: new dashboard draft created: https://grafana.redwood.dev/d/alerts/alert-orch-circuit-breaker (private link)
Maya: customer check — 1 support ticket referencing slowness (non-prod user). no production-wide errors. lowering severity of live mitigation to "noise-suppression" mode.
David: starting step 1 now (silence route and set dedupe). will post logs.
deploy-bot: rollout of alertmanager changes started by David. job_id=rb-alert-23712
David: ran amtool silence add — succeeded. patch applied. PD dedupe window adjusted to 120s for alerts/model-serving via route config.
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty routing updated: dedupe_window=120s, target=oncall; suppressed=low-priority. change_id=PD-98321
Maya: monitoring shows page rate dropping: 450 -> 90 in 6m. latency tail still elevated but trending down.
Jon: good. keep circuit-breaker for 20m and then gradual rollback if stable. open follow-up ticket to tune thresholds and add histogram-based alerting to avoid spike sensitivity.
David: creating follow-up ticket: #ENG-4821 "Alert orchestration: implement circuit-breaker and histogram alerts for model-serving" assigning to Ingrid + Jon.
Ingrid: note — recommend adding KV cache hit-rate as a companion metric for future alerts; noisy model had cache thrash. Adding to ticket.
Maya: will update support thread and mention suppression to avoid duplicate PD escalations.
monitoring-bot: alert rate normalized to 12 pages in last 10m.
Jon: schedule a post-incident review tomorrow 10:30 PT. focus areas: alert noise root cause, dedupe/grouping windows, dashboarding, and alert sampling policy.
Maya: thanks team — I
